**Detailed Explanation :**- 

__
 
• The line MN is the mirror.
 
• The word " **em268q**" ends with " [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af0539be0334c98560006638992224725438d41e2f5a44d81c0127e1ba367d1e.png] " So, the mirror image will start with " [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d583dc9ba5adac113b0d519ea2b5d62a22c05bf99c046ed632e8de71cfc7d649.png] "Hence, option 1, 2 and 4 are eliminated.

Hence, Option 3) is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• In a mirror image Left changes to right and the right changes to left where top and bottom remains the same.
 
• When placement of mirror not given, by default we will assume it in vertical direction.
 
• The starting letter word will be at last after the mirror image drawn with left changes to right and right changes to left.
